parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Whether the control takes focus when it first appears.
parameters.title: The primary heading.
parameters.subtitle: Secondary information displayed beside the heading.
parameters.note: Supporting text displayed with the primary content.
parameters.leading: Places a widget before the main label.
parameters.trailing: A figure or a NeumorphicStatus beside the title, held to a share of the row.
parameters.action: Places a secondary action beside the row’s contents.
parameters.selected: Indicates whether the item is selected.
parameters.isFirst: Applies the treatment for the first row in a group.
parameters.top: The mark stands at the row's top, for a meta that may wrap.

keyboardNote: Neumorphism takes the pressed row’s title as its accessible name. This example keeps the read status in the title so it is also spoken.
